summary.text: David Rardin is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Grafton 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Heather Baldwin.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired Air Force physicist and lawyer who lives on a family farm in Thornton.

paragraphs.text: David Rardin served in the U.S. Air Force from 1980 to 1984.
He earned a high school diploma from Highland Park High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts in 1980, and a law degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was an Air Force physicist, then worked in the defense industry, became a lawyer in his 40s, and is now retired.
Rardin said in the survey that he is a widower, lives on a farm his family bought in 1903, and is a member of the Campton Baptist Church.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Grafton 4 on September 8, 2026.
He listed religious freedom, private property, parental rights and state's rights as rights he supports, and tax growth, non-citizen voting and free speech among his concerns.
